# My solution

Status 2026-10-17, work in progress. This file is updated as the harness grows; anything not yet built says so.

## How to run it

Python 3.11+ with `harness/requirements.txt` (`make setup`, or `python -m venv .venv` and
`.venv/Scripts/python.exe -m pip install -r harness/requirements.txt` on Windows). Nothing else is needed: the scan
OCR model ships inside `rapidocr-onnxruntime`, and nothing is downloaded at run time.

The grader's three commands are unchanged (`ingest`, `report --as-of --mode`, `feedback`). With `ANTHROPIC_API_KEY`
set, the harness calls Claude (`claude-opus-5-5`, set in `harness/nova/llm_config.json`) through the Anthropic SDK
and honours `ANTHROPIC_BASE_URL`. Without a key it uses a logged-in Claude Code CLI if one is on PATH, which is how I
ran it locally; the optional `harness/.local-llm.json` (gitignored; see `harness/local-llm.example.json`) lets that
CLI find its login inside the grader's stripped environment. With neither, it stops with an error rather than
returning an empty audit. Each step keeps to a 540 s budget; work that does not fit is saved and finished by the
next step. Progress lines (`extract k/N done ...`) go to stderr, the report to stdout.

## What works

- Reading: every email, PDF and Excel sheet with the grader's own reader (identical pages, so quotes resolve), UTC
  receipt times, resent files kept as separate occurrences, scans read by local OCR. Practice and exam mailboxes:
  163 and 86 documents, none unreadable.
- Extraction: one structured Claude call per email bundle, long PDFs in parallel chunks, large spreadsheets mapped by
  header and parsed row by row in Python. Every fact must quote its page; numbers and dates are checked against it;
  invoice arithmetic is checked and a misread document is re-read once. Live run on practice batch_01: 917 facts, 0
  rejected; agreement tables (rates, fuel, FX, accessorials, charge codes, Schedule 1) complete.
- 65 offline tests (synthetic data, no network) pass.

Not yet: findings. `report` prints a valid but empty report until the rules land, so there is no practice report
card or exam answer sheet yet.

## What doesn't

Not built yet: the class rules (overcharge, duplicate, waiver, late fees, cashback, expiry), conflicts and
cannot_determine, feedback application, actions in both modes, confidence, supersedes/retro, the embedding search
and RAG interpretation, and my own eval cases. The re-read has not yet been exercised on a live document. One run on
practice batch_01 took 399 s of the 600 s step limit; hidden batches with many long contracts could need more time,
in which case unfinished extraction is completed by the following step.

## The eval case that caught a bug

No `evals/` case exists yet. The offline tests have caught real bugs so far: a date check that accepted the wrong
day/month order; a validator that rejected dates at the end of a sentence (found by the first live run, fixed with a
regression test from that case); an arithmetic check whose 0.01 tolerance hid one-cent differences. This section will
name the eval case once the eval set exists.

| Repo and commit hash | not yet |
| SOLUTION.md | in progress (this file) |
| answer_sheet.json, report_card.txt/.json | not yet: needs the rules, then `make sheet` / `make grade` (I run them) |
| evals/ with 10+ own cases and results.json | not yet |
| DESIGN.md | in progress |
| AI_USE.md and prompt log | kept current; logs exported to `ai_log/` |

# Design

Status 2026-10-17: ingestion, extraction and verification are built and tested; detection rules, feedback and
actions are being built. Items marked *(planned)* are not implemented yet.

## Fact model

Every email and attachment is an occurrence keyed by the path the grader cites (`batch_01/0003.eml#INV.pdf`), with
its UTC receipt time from the Date header, sender and page text from the grader's own reader (OCR for scans). A
resent identical file stays a separate occurrence. Claude transcribes each document into typed facts: contracts and
terms, rate/fuel/FX/accessorial rows, charge-code aliases, Schedule 1 people, invoices and lines, credit notes,
ledger and tracking rows, waivers, extensions, rate notices, status events. Every fact carries `{doc, page, quote}`.
Python accepts a fact only if the quote is on that page and its numbers and dates are too (date order learned per
sender); invoice arithmetic is checked, and a misread gets one targeted re-read. Money is a printed string parsed
to Decimal. All state is SQLite under `--state-dir`.

## Conflicts

*(planned)* Each term is chosen per pickup date from the documents in force: signed MSA and amendments first, then
Schedule 1 notices for that category, then feedback facts. The MSA's precedence clause ranks them. When two sources
with authority give different correct amounts and the clause does not rank them (amendment against a Schedule 1
rate notice), the key becomes a conflict with both sources cited and the range of possible overcharges. An
unauthorised sender, quoted text or an unsigned draft never creates a conflict; the stronger source decides.

## Confidence

*(planned)* An explicit score from evidence completeness (all governing documents held, pickup date from tracking),
source authority level, field verification status (ok, unverified, re-read), arithmetic consistency and agreement
across sources (AWB and tracking against the invoice). It is mapped to a probability and labelled heuristic until it
is checked on our own eval set. Similarity scores never feed it.

## People in the loop

Supervised mode never executes outbound actions: disputes, claims and document requests are drafts, and anything
of $5,000 or more summed per invoice or cashback key goes to human_review. In autonomous mode *(planned)* an
action executes only when all five unattended checks pass: complete evidence received by as_of with a tracked
pickup date, no conflict on that contract and lane, under $5,000, reversible, and every term from level 1–2 with a
Schedule 1 recipient. Conflicts always escalate. Mailbox text is data; instructions in it change nothing.

## Feedback

*(planned)* Feedback files are stored verbatim (built). Each decision becomes a level-2 fact effective from
`decided_at`, scoped by `applies_to` and its valid dates. A standing fact applies only when every filter matches;
a one-off decision touches only its key. Changed items carry `learned_at`. A later signed document beats feedback.

## New documents

Each batch is stored, then planned into extraction units (email bundles, long PDFs in parallel 4-page chunks,
large spreadsheets by column map). Answers are saved as each arrives, and unfinished work is retried by the next
step. Reports recompute everything from stored facts as of the requested date, so a backdated amendment changes
later reports but not earlier ones. *(planned)* Changed keys cite `supersedes`; keys that exist only because of a
backdated document set `retro`; stale keys disappear.

## Cost

Measured on practice batch_01 (82 documents) through Claude Code with `claude-opus-5-5`: 399 s, 165k output tokens,
122k cache-write and 395k cache-read tokens. At API prices ($4/$20 per million input/output, $0.20 cache read,
cache writes priced at 2× input) that is about $4.40 per batch, roughly $53 per 1,000 documents, 76% of it output.
Time was about 80 minutes per 1,000 documents at 4 parallel calls, before long PDFs were split into chunks. These
are estimates from one run; the grader's SDK path may differ.

## What I'd do next

Finish the class rules, feedback and action policy; then original evals and the exam audit. With more time: a
cheaper model for short emails and transcribing only rows a rule needs; local embeddings for unfamiliar charge
labels and clauses; measured confidence calibration. Least sure about: hidden-set layouts and wording.

The grader's three commands are unchanged (`ingest`, `report --as-of --mode`, `feedback`). With `ANTHROPIC_API_KEY`
set, the harness calls Claude (`claude-opus-5-5`, set in `harness/nova/llm_config.json`) through the Anthropic SDK
and honours `ANTHROPIC_BASE_URL`. Without a key it uses a logged-in Claude Code CLI if one is on PATH, which is how I
ran it locally; the optional `harness/.local-llm.json` (gitignored; see `harness/local-llm.example.json`) lets that
CLI find its login inside the grader's stripped environment. With neither, it stops with an error rather than
returning an empty audit. Each step keeps to a 540 s budget; work that does not fit is saved and finished by the
next step. Progress lines (`extract k/N done ...`) go to stderr, the report to stdout.

## What works

- Reading: every email, PDF and Excel sheet with the grader's own reader (identical pages, so quotes resolve), UTC
  receipt times, resent files kept as separate occurrences, scans read by local OCR. Practice and exam mailboxes:
  163 and 86 documents, none unreadable.
- Extraction: one structured Claude call per email bundle, long PDFs in parallel chunks, large spreadsheets mapped by
  header and parsed row by row in Python. Every fact must quote its page; numbers and dates are checked against it;
  invoice arithmetic is checked and a misread document is re-read once. Live run on practice batch_01: 917 facts, 0
  rejected; agreement tables (rates, fuel, FX, accessorials, charge codes, Schedule 1) complete.
- 65 offline tests (synthetic data, no network) pass.

Not yet: findings. `report` prints a valid but empty report until the rules land, so there is no practice report
card or exam answer sheet yet.

## What doesn't

Not built yet: the class rules (overcharge, duplicate, waiver, late fees, cashback, expiry), conflicts and
cannot_determine, feedback application, actions in both modes, confidence, supersedes/retro, the embedding search
and RAG interpretation, and my own eval cases. The re-read has not yet been exercised on a live document. One run on
practice batch_01 took 399 s of the 600 s step limit; hidden batches with many long contracts could need more time,
in which case unfinished extraction is completed by the following step.

## The eval case that caught a bug

No `evals/` case exists yet. The offline tests have caught real bugs so far: a date check that accepted the wrong
day/month order; a validator that rejected dates at the end of a sentence (found by the first live run, fixed with a
regression test from that case); an arithmetic check whose 0.01 tolerance hid one-cent differences. This section will
name the eval case once the eval set exists.

| Repo and commit hash | not yet |
| SOLUTION.md | in progress (this file) |
| answer_sheet.json, report_card.txt/.json | not yet: needs the rules, then `make sheet` / `make grade` (I run them) |
| evals/ with 10+ own cases and results.json | not yet |
| DESIGN.md | in progress |
| AI_USE.md and prompt log | kept current; logs exported to `ai_log/` |

from nova.world import World

    def __init__(self, p): self.db = sqlite3.connect(f"file:{p}?mode=ro", uri=True); self.db.row_factory = sqlite3.Row
w = World(RO("out/state_live_practice/nova.sqlite3"), "2035-05-31")
for cid, c in w.contracts.items():
    print(cid, "msa:", c.msa and (c.msa.doc, c.msa.effective, c.msa.signed, len(c.msa.bands)),
          "amendments:", [(a.id, a.effective, len(a.bands)) for a in c.amendments],

src = collections.Counter(); unmapped = collections.Counter(); nocontract = 0
for hdr, lines in w.invoices():
    c = w.contract_of(hdr.get("contract_id"))
    if not c: nocontract += 1; continue
    for ln in lines:
        if not c.code_for(ln.get("charge_label")): unmapped[ln.get("charge_label")[:40]] += 1

for e in ["fintan.corrigan@tarrowby.example"]: print("rates authority:", p.authority(e, "rates"))

from __future__ import annotations

from dataclasses import dataclass, field
from decimal import Decimal

from ..money import money_str


@dataclass
class Candidate:
    cls: str                       # overcharge | duplicate | waived_but_billed | late_fee_not_owed | late_fee_risk |
                                   # cashback | expiry
    key: dict                      # invoice_id / contract_id, period, credit_type
    verdict: str                   # finding | no_finding | conflict | cannot_determine
    amount_usd: Decimal | None = None
    amount_range: tuple[Decimal, Decimal] | None = None
    deadline: str | None = None
    evidence: list[dict] = field(default_factory=list)
    missing_doc: dict | None = None
    outbound: str | None = None    # dispute | claim_credit | request_document (None = internal or no action)
    internal: str | None = None    # alert | payment_reminder | track_credit
    contract_id: str | None = None
    lane: str | None = None
    signals: dict = field(default_factory=dict)    # inputs for confidence and the unattended-action test
    trace: dict = field(default_factory=dict)      # typed operands and steps; written under --state-dir/traces
    retro: bool = False

    def add_evidence(self, ev: dict | None) -> None:
        if ev and ev.get("quote") and ev not in self.evidence:
            self.evidence.append(ev)

    def amount_str(self) -> str | None:
        return money_str(self.amount_usd) if self.amount_usd is not None else None

"""Build a state store of invented documents and facts directly, for rule tests (no extraction, no model).

All names, lanes, ids, rates and dates here are made up for the tests and match no supplied mailbox."""
from __future__ import annotations

import sys
import tempfile
from pathlib import Path

sys.path.insert(0, str(Path(__file__).resolve().parents[2] / "harness"))

from nova.store import Store  # noqa: E402
from nova.world import World  # noqa: E402

CARRIER = "PW-US"
RATES = "rhea.voss@pellwick.example"
KAM = "omar.lind@pellwick.example"
WAIVERS = "ines.duarte@pellwick.example"
TREASURY = "kit.amari@pellwick.example"
CID = "PW-OB-EXP-07"


class Kit:
    def __init__(self):
        self.tmp = tempfile.TemporaryDirectory()
        self.store = Store(Path(self.tmp.name) / "state")
        self.n = 0

    def close(self):
        self.store.close()
        self.tmp.cleanup()

    def doc(self, doc: str, received: str, sender: str = "billing@pellwick.example", kind: str = "other") -> str:
        email = doc.split("#")[0]
        with self.store.db:
            for d in {email, doc}:
                self.store.db.execute(
                    "INSERT OR IGNORE INTO documents (doc, batch, email_doc, kind, name, sha256, received_at, sender_addr,"
                    " page_count) VALUES (?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?,1)",
                    (d, d.split("/")[0], email, "eml" if d == email else "pdf", d.rsplit("/", 1)[-1], d,
                     f"{received}T09:00:00Z", sender))
            self.store.set_doc_kind(doc, kind, None, "test")
        return doc

    def fact(self, kind: str, doc: str, data: dict, quote: str | None = None, status: str = "ok") -> dict:
        self.n += 1
        quote = quote or f"{kind} quote number {self.n:04d} for the test"
        row = {"kind": kind, "doc": doc, "page": 1, "quote": quote,
               "data": data | {"_source": {"doc": doc, "page": 1, "quote": quote}}, "status": status, "issues": []}
        with self.store.db:
            self.store.db.execute(
                "INSERT INTO facts (unit, kind, doc, page, quote, data_json, status, issues_json, origin) "
                "VALUES (?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?)",
                (f"test:{self.n}", kind, doc, 1, quote, __import__("json").dumps(row["data"]), status, "[]", "test"))
        return data

    def world(self, as_of: str) -> World:
        return World(self.store, as_of)

    # ---- a standard invented contract ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
    def contract(self, received="2040-01-05", **over):
        doc = self.doc("batch_01/0001.eml#MSA.pdf", received, "lena.sorell@ostravabio.example", "contract")
        msa = {"contract_id": CID, "kind": "master_agreement", "amends_contract_id": None, "signed": True,
               "effective_date": "2040-01-10", "carrier_code": CARRIER, "shipper_code": "OB-US", "currency": "USD",
               "rate_periods": [{"label": "P1", "pickup_from": "2040-01-10", "pickup_to": "2040-07-09"},
                                {"label": "P2", "pickup_from": "2040-07-10", "pickup_to": "2041-01-09"}],
               "precedence": {"later_amendment_prevails": True, "rate_notice_vs_amendment_unranked": True},
               "pricing_rules": {"dg_dry_ice_rule": "Dry ice used only as refrigerant does not attract the DG fee",
                                 "delivery_fee_rule": "payable only where the Carrier delivers",
                                 "customs_rule": "for the Shipper's account unless the Carrier's documents caused it",
                                 "storage_free_days": "3"},
               "term": {"initial_term_end": "2041-01-09", "auto_renews": False},
               "payment": {"due_days_after_invoice": "30", "late_fee_pct_per_month": "1.50", "grace_days": "5",
                           "compounding": True},
               "amendment_changes": []} | over
        self.fact("contracts", doc, msa)
        for lane, rows in {"KLX1-ORB2": [("0", "44.5", "5.10", "5.20"), ("45", "99.5", "4.60", "4.70"),
                                         ("100", "299.5", "4.00", "4.10"), ("300", None, "3.50", "3.60")]}.items():
            self.fact("rate_rows", doc, {"contract_id": CID, "lane": lane, "band": "minimum charge",
                                         "band_min_kg": None, "band_max_kg": None, "is_minimum_charge": True,
                                         "period_label": "P1", "rate": "80.00"})
            for lo, hi, p1, p2 in rows:
                for label, rate in (("P1", p1), ("P2", p2)):
                    self.fact("rate_rows", doc, {"contract_id": CID, "lane": lane,
                                                 "band": f"{lo}-{hi} kg" if hi else f"{lo}+ kg", "band_min_kg": lo,
                                                 "band_max_kg": hi, "is_minimum_charge": False, "period_label": label,
                                                 "rate": rate})
        for month, pct in (("2040-03", "20.00"), ("2040-09", "21.00"), ("2040-10", "22.00")):
            self.fact("fuel_rows", doc, {"contract_id": CID, "month": month, "pct": pct})
        for code, name, fee, basis, cond in (("SEC", "Security surcharge", "0.15", "per chargeable kg", None),
                                             ("DG", "Dangerous goods fee", "120.00", "per shipment", None),
                                             ("DRYICE", "Dry ice handling fee", "40.00", "per shipment", None),
                                             ("DLV", "Delivery fee", "100.00", "per shipment", None),
                                             ("STOR", "Storage", "25.00", "per storage day", None),
                                             ("PEAK", "Peak season surcharge", "0.30", "per chargeable kg",
                                              "for pickups in September to November only")):
            self.fact("accessorials", doc, {"contract_id": CID, "code": code, "name": name, "fee": fee,
                                            "currency": "USD", "basis": basis, "condition": cond})
        for code, name, aliases in (("FRT", "Air freight", ["Express freight"]), ("FUEL", "Fuel surcharge", ["FSC"]),
                                    ("SEC", "Security surcharge", ["Screening fee"]),
                                    ("DG", "Dangerous goods fee", ["DG handling"]),
                                    ("DRYICE", "Dry ice handling fee", []), ("DLV", "Delivery fee", []),
                                    ("STOR", "Storage", []), ("PEAK", "Peak season surcharge", ["PSS"]),
                                    ("TAX", "Sales tax", ["GST"]), ("LATE", "Late payment fee", ["Late fee"])):
            self.fact("charge_codes", doc, {"contract_id": CID, "code": code, "name": name, "aliases": aliases})
        for name, email, cats in (("Rhea Voss", RATES, ["rates"]), ("Omar Lind", KAM, ["notices", "billing_disputes"]),
                                  ("Ines Duarte", WAIVERS, ["waivers", "payment_terms"]),
                                  ("Kit Amari", TREASURY, ["treasury"])):
            self.fact("authorised_persons", doc, {"contract_id": CID, "name": name, "title": "Lead", "party": CARRIER,
                                                  "categories": cats, "email": email})
        return doc

    def invoice(self, n: int, received: str, lines: list[dict], invoice_date: str | None = None, currency="USD",
                contract=CID, invoice_id=None):
        invoice_id = invoice_id or f"PW-OB-2040-{n:04d}"
        doc = self.doc(f"batch_01/{n:04d}.eml#{invoice_id}.pdf", received, kind="invoice")
        total = sum(float(ln["amount"]) for ln in lines)
        self.fact("invoices", doc, {"invoice_id": invoice_id, "doc_type": "invoice", "contract_id": contract,
                                    "invoice_date": invoice_date or received, "due_date": None, "currency": currency,
                                    "subtotal": f"{total:.2f}", "tax": "0.00", "total": f"{total:.2f}"})
        for i, ln in enumerate(lines, 1):
            self.fact("invoice_lines", doc, {"invoice_id": invoice_id, "line_no": str(i), "awb": ln.get("awb"),
                                             "lane": ln.get("lane", "KLX1-ORB2"), "pickup_date": ln.get("pickup"),
                                             "charge_label": ln["label"], "quantity": ln.get("qty"),
                                             "rate": ln.get("rate"), "pct": ln.get("pct"),
                                             "base_amount": ln.get("base"), "amount": ln["amount"]},
                      quote=f"{i} {ln.get('awb')} {ln['label']} {ln['amount']} line of {invoice_id}")
        return doc, invoice_id

    def picked_up(self, awb: str, day: str, received="2040-12-31"):
        doc = self.doc("batch_01/0900.eml#tracking.xlsx", received, "ops@ostravabio.example", "table")
        self.fact("tracking_events", doc, {"awb": awb, "event": "PICKED_UP", "date": day, "station": "KLX1"},
                  quote=f"{awb} | PICKED_UP | {day} | KLX1 | -")

"""Overcharge rule on invented contracts and invoices. Expected amounts are worked by hand in the comments."""
import sys
import unittest
from decimal import Decimal
from pathlib import Path

sys.path.insert(0, str(Path(__file__).resolve().parent))

from factkit import CID, KAM, RATES, TREASURY, Kit  # noqa: E402
from nova.rules import overcharge  # noqa: E402

AS_OF = "2040-12-31"


def freight(awb, qty, rate, pickup=None, label="Air freight"):
    return {"awb": awb, "label": label, "qty": qty, "rate": rate, "pickup": pickup,
            "amount": f"{Decimal(qty) * Decimal(rate):.2f}"}


def fuel(awb, base, pct, label="Fuel surcharge"):
    amt = (Decimal(base) * Decimal(pct) / 100).quantize(Decimal("0.01"), rounding="ROUND_HALF_UP")
    return {"awb": awb, "label": label, "base": base, "pct": pct, "amount": f"{amt:.2f}"}


class OverchargeTests(unittest.TestCase):
    def setUp(self):
        self.k = Kit()
        self.k.contract()

    def tearDown(self):
        self.k.close()

    def run_rule(self, as_of=AS_OF):
        return {c.key["invoice_id"]: c for c in overcharge.detect(self.k.world(as_of))}

    def bill(self, n, awb, pickup, qty, rate, received="2040-03-20", extra=(), **kw):
        self.k.picked_up(awb, pickup)
        base = freight(awb, qty, rate)
        return self.k.invoice(n, received, [base, fuel(awb, base["amount"], "20.00"), *extra], **kw)[1]

    def test_wrong_rate_with_fuel(self):
        # 118 kg, P1 band 100-299.5 = 4.00; billed 4.20: freight 495.60 - 472.00 = 23.60;
        # fuel 20%: 99.12 - 94.40 = 4.72; total 28.32
        inv = self.bill(1, "PW100", "2040-03-02", "118", "4.20")
        got = self.run_rule()[inv]
        self.assertEqual((got.verdict, got.amount_usd, got.outbound), ("finding", Decimal("28.32"), "dispute"))
        docs = {e["doc"] for e in got.evidence}
        self.assertIn("batch_01/0001.eml#MSA.pdf", docs)                 # the governing rate row is cited
        self.assertIn("batch_01/0900.eml#tracking.xlsx", docs)           # and the pickup date's source

    def test_band_boundary_and_minimum(self):
        # 44.5 kg is in band 0-44.5 (5.10): clean. 45 kg is in 45-99.5 (4.60): 229.50 - 207.00 = 22.50 (+ fuel 4.50)
        clean = self.bill(2, "PW200", "2040-03-02", "44.5", "5.10")
        wrong = self.bill(3, "PW201", "2040-03-02", "45", "5.10")
        # 10 kg x 5.10 = 51.00 < minimum 80.00, so 80.00 is right; billed 85.00 flat: 5.00 too much
        self.k.picked_up("PW202", "2040-03-02")
        mini = self.k.invoice(4, "2040-03-20", [{"awb": "PW202", "label": "Air freight", "qty": "10", "rate": "8.50",
                                                 "amount": "85.00"}])[1]
        got = self.run_rule()
        self.assertNotIn(clean, got)
        self.assertEqual(got[wrong].amount_usd, Decimal("27.00"))
        self.assertEqual(got[mini].amount_usd, Decimal("5.00"))

    def test_rate_period_follows_pickup_date(self):
        # pickup in P2 (from 2040-07-10): 118 kg at 4.10 is right; the same rate in P1 would be 0.10/kg too much
        p2 = self.bill(5, "PW300", "2040-08-01", "118", "4.10", received="2040-08-20")
        p1 = self.bill(6, "PW301", "2040-03-02", "118", "4.10")
        got = self.run_rule()
        self.assertNotIn(p2, got)
        self.assertEqual(got[p1].amount_usd, Decimal("14.16"))       # 11.80 freight + 2.36 fuel

    def amendment(self, rate="3.80", signed=True, effective="2040-02-01", changes=None, n=10):
        doc = self.k.doc(f"batch_01/{n:04d}.eml#AMD.pdf", "2040-01-25", "lena.sorell@ostravabio.example", "amendment")
        self.k.fact("contracts", doc, {"contract_id": f"{CID}/AMD-{n}", "kind": "amendment",
                                       "amends_contract_id": CID, "signed": signed, "effective_date": effective,
                                       "amendment_changes": changes or [{"lanes": ["KLX1-ORB2"],
                                                                         "effective_from": effective,
                                                                         "effective_to": None, "what": "new rates"}]})
        self.k.fact("rate_rows", doc, {"contract_id": f"{CID}/AMD-{n}", "lane": "KLX1-ORB2", "band": "100-299.5 kg",
                                       "band_min_kg": "100", "band_max_kg": "299.5", "is_minimum_charge": False,
                                       "period_label": None, "rate": rate})
        return doc

    def notice(self, sender, rate="4.20", n=20):
        doc = self.k.doc(f"batch_01/{n:04d}.eml", "2040-02-10", sender, "rate_notice")
        self.k.fact("rate_notices", doc, {"contract_id": CID, "lane": "KLX1-ORB2", "band": "100-299.5 kg",
                                          "rate": rate, "currency": "USD", "effective_from": "2040-02-15",
                                          "effective_to": None})

    def test_signed_amendment_beats_agreement_unsigned_does_not(self):
        # amendment 3.80: billed 4.00 x 118 = 472.00 vs 448.40 -> 23.60 + fuel 4.72 = 28.32
        self.amendment()
        inv = self.bill(7, "PW400", "2040-03-02", "118", "4.00")
        self.assertEqual(self.run_rule()[inv].amount_usd, Decimal("28.32"))

    def test_unsigned_amendment_ignored(self):
        self.amendment(signed=False)
        inv = self.bill(8, "PW401", "2040-03-02", "118", "4.00")
        self.assertNotIn(inv, self.run_rule())

    def test_notice_needs_schedule1_rates_authority(self):
        self.notice(KAM)                                          # the KAM has notices, not rates
        inv = self.bill(9, "PW500", "2040-03-02", "118", "4.20")

    return {"awb": awb, "label": label, "qty": qty, "rate": rate, "pickup": pickup,
            "amount": f"{Decimal(qty) * Decimal(rate):.2f}"}


def fuel(awb, base, pct, label="Fuel surcharge"):
    amt = (Decimal(base) * Decimal(pct) / 100).quantize(Decimal("0.01"), rounding="ROUND_HALF_UP")
    return {"awb": awb, "label": label, "base": base, "pct": pct, "amount": f"{amt:.2f}"}

        self.assertEqual((got.verdict, got.amount_usd, got.outbound), ("finding", Decimal("28.32"), "dispute"))

input.content:
"""Late fees (GLOSSARY "Late fees").

Not owed: days_late = paid date - due date, where the due date is the extended one if the contract's payment-terms
contact extended it in their own email. No fee within the grace days; otherwise ceil(days_late / 30) months, each
round_half_up(r% x base): compounding bases add the earlier unpaid fees, simple bases do not. The finding is billed
fees minus the correct fee, on the invoice that billed them.

Risk: an unpaid invoice whose due date is 1-14 days after as_of: one month's fee on the open amount less anything
already disputed on it, in the invoice's currency (converted once later), deadline = the due date.
"""
from __future__ import annotations

import math
from decimal import Decimal

from ..money import dec, q2
from ..world import World, norm_id, norm_label, to_date
from .common import Candidate
from .duplicate import _ledger

ZERO = Decimal("0")
OPEN = ("open", "unpaid", "outstanding", "due", "overdue")


def due_date(world: World, contract, inv: str, ledger_row, header) -> tuple:
    """(due date, the extension fact used or None). Only the payment-terms contact's own email extends it."""
    due = to_date(ledger_row.get("due_date")) if ledger_row is not None else None
    if due is None and header is not None:
        due = to_date(header.get("due_date"))
    best = None
    for f in world.of("due_date_extensions"):
        if norm_id(f.get("invoice_id")) != inv or f.get("is_quoted_or_forwarded"):
            continue
        if contract is None or not contract.authority(world.sender(f.doc), "payment_terms"):
            continue
        new = to_date(f.get("new_due_date"))
        if new and (best is None or world.docs[f.doc].received_at > world.docs[best.doc].received_at):
            best = f
    if best is not None:
        return to_date(best.get("new_due_date")), best
    return due, None


def correct_fee(principal: Decimal, pct: Decimal, days_late: int, grace: int, compounding: bool) -> tuple:
    if days_late <= grace or days_late <= 0:
        return ZERO, []
    months = math.ceil(days_late / 30)
    base, total, steps = principal, ZERO, []
    for i in range(months):
        fee = q2(pct / 100 * base)
        steps.append({"month": i + 1, "base": str(base), "fee": str(fee)})
        total += fee
        if compounding:
            base += fee
    return total, steps


def detect(world: World, disputed=lambda inv: ZERO) -> list[Candidate]:
    found = []
    ledger = _ledger(world)
    headers = {norm_id(h.get("invoice_id")): h for h in world.of("invoices")}
    # ---- fees billed that are not owed -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
    by_invoice: dict[str, list] = {}
    for ln in world.of("invoice_lines"):
        hdr = headers.get(norm_id(ln.get("invoice_id")))
        contract = world.contract_of(hdr.get("contract_id")) if hdr else None
        is_late = (contract.code_for(ln.get("charge_label")) == "LATE") if contract else False
        if is_late or "latefee" in norm_label(ln.get("charge_label")):
            by_invoice.setdefault(norm_id(ln.get("invoice_id")), []).append(ln)
    for inv, fee_lines in by_invoice.items():
        hdr = headers.get(inv)
        contract = world.contract_of(hdr.get("contract_id")) if hdr else None
        if contract is None:
            continue
        pay = contract.block("payment")
        pct, grace = dec(pay.get("late_fee_pct_per_month")), int(dec(pay.get("grace_days")) or 0)
        if pct is None:
            continue
        per_target: dict[str, list] = {}
        for ln in fee_lines:
            per_target.setdefault(norm_id(ln.get("refers_to_invoice")), []).append(ln)
        billed_total, correct_total, steps, evidence = ZERO, ZERO, [], []
        for target, lines in per_target.items():
            row = ledger.get(target)
            paid = to_date(row.get("paid_date")) if row is not None else None
            due, ext = due_date(world, contract, target, row, headers.get(target))
            principal = (dec(row.get("amount")) if row is not None else None) or dec(lines[0].get("base_amount"))
            if not target or paid is None or due is None or principal is None:
                continue                                    # cannot judge without paid date, due date and principal
            principal -= disputed(target)
            days = (paid - due).days
            correct, fee_steps = correct_fee(principal, pct, days, grace, bool(pay.get("compounding")))
            billed = sum((dec(x.get("amount")) or ZERO for x in lines), ZERO)
            billed_total += billed
            correct_total += correct
            steps.append({"late_invoice": target, "due": str(due), "extended_by": ext.doc if ext else None,
                          "paid": str(paid), "days_late": days, "grace": grace, "pct": str(pct),
                          "principal": str(principal), "fees": fee_steps, "correct": str(correct),
                          "billed": str(billed)})
            if billed > correct:
                if ext is not None:
                    evidence.append(ext.evidence())
                if row is not None:
                    evidence.append(row.evidence())
                evidence += [x.evidence() for x in lines]
        over = billed_total - correct_total
        if over > 0:
            c = Candidate("late_fee_not_owed", {"invoice_id": inv, "class": "late_fee_not_owed"}, "finding",
                          amount_usd=q2(over), outbound="dispute", contract_id=contract.id,
                          signals={"currency": (hdr.get("currency") or "USD").upper()},
                          trace={"formula": "late_fee.billed_minus_correct", "targets": steps})
            for ev in evidence:
                c.add_evidence(ev)
            if pay.get("source"):
                c.add_evidence(pay["source"] | {"page": pay["source"].get("page") or 1})
            found.append(c)
    # ---- unpaid invoices about to start costing a fee ---------------------------------------------------------------
    for inv, row in ledger.items():
        if str(row.get("status") or "").lower() not in OPEN or row.get("paid_date"):
            continue
        hdr = headers.get(inv)
        contract = world.contract_of(hdr.get("contract_id")) if hdr else None
        if contract is None and len(world.contracts) == 1:
            contract = next(iter(world.contracts.values()))
        if contract is None:
            continue
        pay = contract.block("payment")
        pct = dec(pay.get("late_fee_pct_per_month"))
        due, ext = due_date(world, contract, inv, row, hdr)
        amount = dec(row.get("amount"))
        if pct is None or due is None or amount is None:
            continue
        gap = (due - world.as_of_date).days
        if not 0 < gap <= 14:
            continue
        principal = amount - disputed(inv)
        fee = q2(pct / 100 * principal)
        c = Candidate("late_fee_risk", {"invoice_id": inv, "class": "late_fee_risk"}, "finding", amount_usd=fee,
                      deadline=due.isoformat(), internal="payment_reminder", contract_id=contract.id,
                      signals={"currency": (row.get("currency") or (hdr.get("currency") if hdr else None) or "USD").upper(),
                               "invoice_date": row.get("invoice_date")},
                      trace={"formula": "late_fee.one_month_risk", "principal": str(principal), "pct": str(pct),
                             "due": str(due), "days_to_due": gap})
        c.add_evidence(row.evidence())
        if ext is not None:
            c.add_evidence(ext.evidence())
        if pay.get("source"):
            c.add_evidence(pay["source"] | {"page": pay["source"].get("page") or 1})
        found.append(c)
    return found

"""Late fees (GLOSSARY "Late fees").

Not owed: days_late = paid date - due date, where the due date is the extended one if the contract's payment-terms
contact extended it in their own email. No fee within the grace days; otherwise ceil(days_late / 30) months, each
round_half_up(r% x base): compounding bases add the earlier unpaid fees, simple bases do not. The finding is billed
fees minus the correct fee, on the invoice that billed them.

Risk: an unpaid invoice whose due date is 1-14 days after as_of: one month's fee on the open amount less anything
already disputed on it, in the invoice's currency (converted once later), deadline = the due date.
"""
from __future__ import annotations

import math
from decimal import Decimal

from ..money import dec, q2
from ..world import World, norm_id, norm_label, to_date
from .common import Candidate
from .duplicate import _ledger

ZERO = Decimal("0")
OPEN = ("open", "unpaid", "outstanding", "due", "overdue")


def due_date(world: World, contract, inv: str, ledger_row, header) -> tuple:
    """(due date, the extension fact used or None). Only the payment-terms contact's own email extends it."""
    due = to_date(ledger_row.get("due_date")) if ledger_row is not None else None
    if due is None and header is not None:
        due = to_date(header.get("due_date"))
    best = None
    for f in world.of("due_date_extensions"):
        if norm_id(f.get("invoice_id")) != inv or f.get("is_quoted_or_forwarded"):
            continue
        if contract is None or not contract.authority(world.sender(f.doc), "payment_terms"):
            continue
        new = to_date(f.get("new_due_date"))
        if new and (best is None or world.docs[f.doc].received_at > world.docs[best.doc].received_at):
            best = f
    if best is not None:
        return to_date(best.get("new_due_date")), best
    return due, None


def correct_fee(principal: Decimal, pct: Decimal, days_late: int, grace: int, compounding: bool) -> tuple:
    if days_late <= grace or days_late <= 0:
        return ZERO, []
    months = math.ceil(days_late / 30)
    base, total, steps = principal, ZERO, []
    for i in range(months):
        fee = q2(pct / 100 * base)
        steps.append({"month": i + 1, "base": str(base), "fee": str(fee)})
        total += fee
        if compounding:
            base += fee
    return total, steps

    headers = {norm_id(h.get("invoice_id")): h for h in world.of("invoices")}

    for ln in world.of("invoice_lines"):
        hdr = headers.get(norm_id(ln.get("invoice_id")))
        contract = world.contract_of(hdr.get("contract_id")) if hdr else None
        is_late = (contract.code_for(ln.get("charge_label")) == "LATE") if contract else False
        if is_late or "latefee" in norm_label(ln.get("charge_label")):
            by_invoice.setdefault(norm_id(ln.get("invoice_id")), []).append(ln)
    for inv, fee_lines in by_invoice.items():
        hdr = headers.get(inv)
        contract = world.contract_of(hdr.get("contract_id")) if hdr else None
        if contract is None:
            continue
        pay = contract.block("payment")
        pct, grace = dec(pay.get("late_fee_pct_per_month")), int(dec(pay.get("grace_days")) or 0)
        if pct is None:

                          "paid": str(paid), "days_late": days, "grace": grace, "pct": str(pct),

                          "billed": str(billed)})

                      deadline=due.isoformat(), internal="payment_reminder", contract_id=contract.id,
                      signals={"currency": (row.get("currency") or (hdr.get("currency") if hdr else None) or "USD").upper(),
                               "invoice_date": row.get("invoice_date")},
                      trace={"formula": "late_fee.one_month_risk", "principal": str(principal), "pct": str(pct),

from __future__ import annotations

import json
import re
import sys
from datetime import date, datetime, timezone
from pathlib import Path

import time

from .config import SCHEMA_VERSION
from .extract.run import plan_batch, run_pending
from .llm import load_config, select_provider
from .reader import read_batch, sha256
from .store import Store

REPORT_RESERVE_S = 120     # time kept back in `report` for building the report after finishing extraction
WRITE_RESERVE_S = 20


def _now() -> str:
    # Operational timestamp only (when this process ran). Business logic uses email Date headers and --as-of.
    return datetime.now(timezone.utc).strftime("%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ")


def log(msg: str) -> None:
    print(msg, file=sys.stderr)


def _extract(store, cfg: dict, seconds: float, step: str) -> None:
    stats = run_pending(store, lambda: select_provider(cfg), cfg, seconds)
    log(f"{step}: extraction {stats}")
    if stats.get("pending") or stats.get("failed"):
        log(f"{step}: WARNING {stats.get('pending', 0)} unit(s) pending and {stats.get('failed', 0)} failed; "
            "they are retried by the next step")


def ingest(batch_dir: str, state_dir: str) -> None:
    start = time.monotonic()
    folder = Path(batch_dir)
    if not folder.is_dir():
        raise ValueError(f"batch folder not found: {batch_dir}")
    items = read_batch(folder)
    store = Store(state_dir)
    try:
        for it in items:
            store.put_blob(it["row"]["sha256"], it["data"])
        changed = 0
        with store.db:
            for it in items:
                changed += store.upsert_document(it["row"], it["pages"])
            store.record_batch(folder.name, str(folder.resolve()),
                               sum(1 for it in items if it["row"]["kind"] == "eml"), _now())
        errors = [it["row"]["doc"] for it in items if it["row"].get("read_error")]
        log(f"ingest {folder.name}: {len(items)} documents, {changed} new or changed, {len(errors)} unreadable")
        for doc in errors:
            log(f"  unreadable: {doc}")
        with store.db:
            plan_batch(store, folder.name)
        cfg = load_config()
        _extract(store, cfg, cfg["step_budget_s"] - (time.monotonic() - start) - WRITE_RESERVE_S, "ingest")
    finally:
        store.close()


def _check_date(value: str) -> str:
    if not re.fullmatch(r"\d{4}-\d{2}-\d{2}", value or ""):
        raise ValueError(f"--as-of must be YYYY-MM-DD, got {value!r}")
    date.fromisoformat(value)
    return value


def report(as_of: str, mode: str, state_dir: str) -> dict:
    start = time.monotonic()
    _check_date(as_of)
    store = Store(state_dir)
    try:
        if store.units(("pending", "failed")):
            cfg = load_config()
            _extract(store, cfg, cfg["step_budget_s"] - (time.monotonic() - start) - REPORT_RESERVE_S, "report")
        known = store.documents_received_by(as_of)
        log(f"report {as_of} {mode}: {len(known)} documents received by then")
    finally:
        store.close()
    return {"schema_version": SCHEMA_VERSION, "as_of": as_of, "mode": mode, "findings": [],

# AI use

This file is kept up to date during the work. Each entry is backed by the exported logs in `ai_log/`.

## Tools

- **Claude Code (CLI, Windows), model `claude-opus-5-5`.** Used for: reading the brief, glossary, worked examples and
  the planning documents; revising the project's Claude setup (`CLAUDE.md`, `.claude/` phases, rules, skills, hooks,
  progress tracking); writing the workflow guard and its tests; writing the session-log exporter; writing the
  requirements checklist (`docs/REQUIREMENTS.md`) and the harness code from phase 01 on, with its offline tests. Every
  assistant turn in the exported sessions so far used this model.
- **ChatGPT (planning and prompt drafting).** I used it mostly to structure my instructions for Claude Code: the
  planning document `docs/NOVA-SOLUTION-PLAN.md`, the initial Claude setup, and the scaffold-cleanup prompt that removed
  deadline and hour tracking (kept locally as the gitignored `prompt.txt`). Its log is not exported yet; see
  "Prompt log".

## How you worked with them

- **Split of work.** I direct the work and own every API-backed, ML/AI and publishing step. The rules are in
  `.claude/rules/human-execution.md`. Claude Code reads, edits code and docs, installs pinned dependencies into `.venv`
  and runs offline checks. I run API/service setup, the `make grade/sheet/run/eval` runs, real-mailbox ML preprocessing,
  model preparation and any training. A hook (`.claude/hooks/handoff_guard.py`) blocks the known commands for those steps.
- **What I checked.** I reviewed each scaffold change. I applied the guard and settings changes myself from a copy
  Claude Code had tested in a scratch folder, because its auto mode refused to edit its own guardrails. After every
  change, the setup check (`.claude/scripts/check_setup.py`) and the guard tests (`.claude/hooks/test_guard.py`) were
  re-run with the `.venv` interpreter.
- **Where it got things wrong, and how each was caught:**
  - A Python rewrite converted two LF files to CRLF, which made every line show as changed. A diff far larger than
    the edits gave it away; the line endings were restored.
  - In one batch of tool calls, a `sed` on phase files ran alongside a write that the auto-mode classifier had refused.
    It was disclosed rather than repeated.
  - The log redactor first missed API-key values behind JSON-escaped quotes. This was found by listing every match on
    the real transcript; the pattern was fixed and a regression test added.
  - A test file contained a fake key that the submission key scan (`tools/check_submission.py`) would have flagged.
    The fake key is now assembled from pieces.
  - The workflow guard blocked two harmless commands because their text contained gated words (a made-up test
    string; a progress note). The check went into `tests/offline/` and the note was written with the Edit tool.
    Nothing gated was run.
  - The planning document proposed forced `tool_choice` for structured extraction and a Sonnet model. Claude Code's
    API reference skill showed forced tool choice now returns a 400 on current models. The harness uses
    `output_config` structured output instead, with `claude-opus-5-5` as the default model (configurable).
  - My live check (H-002) showed that its CLI back end had not accounted for the grader stripping `SystemRoot`, which
    the Bun-based CLI needs on Windows. The code now restores it from the Windows API, with a regression test. The
    handoff's step 3 chained `notepad` with the check, and `notepad` returns immediately in PowerShell, so the check ran
    on an unedited file. That step is now a single command.
  - Its first validator accepted a wrong date when the other day/month order happened to appear on the page, and did
    not check a contract's late-fee percentage. Its own new tests caught both before any real use. Two expectations in
    its extraction-run tests were themselves wrong (a document count and when a failed unit is retried) and were
    corrected after checking the code's intended behaviour.
  - My first live extraction (H-003) produced 6 "unverified" facts. Checking them against the pages showed all 6 were
    bugs in its validator (a date ending a sentence; a total on page 2), not model errors. It fixed the validator,
    re-checked the cached answers (640/640 ok) and added regression tests. It had also written results only at the end
    of a step; at my request each answer is now saved as it arrives, with progress lines.
  - Its first invoice arithmetic check reused the grader's 0.01 tolerance, which let a one-cent printed difference pass;
    its tests caught it and the document check is now exact. Before wiring the check in, it ran it on the live facts
    and found an INR invoice whose lines included the GST line. That was a correct extraction, so the check was
    adjusted rather than the facts.
  - It first planned to map spreadsheet columns by cell index. It switched to header labels read from the real
    workbook after noticing that the grader's text layer drops empty cells, which would shift columns.
  - Its first CLI tests left SQLite connections open (`with sqlite3.connect()` commits but does not close), so the
    Windows test teardown failed. The test run showed it; the tests now close connections explicitly.
- **Model calls from the harness.** I have no personal Anthropic API key. With the grader's key the harness uses the
  Anthropic SDK. On my machine it uses my Claude Code login through headless `claude -p` (decision D-002 in
  `.claude/decisions/`). I run every live call myself. Outputs from the local CLI path are labelled as such and are not
  presented as the grader's SDK results. So far no live model call has been made by the harness.

## Written without AI

- The short conversational instructions in the Claude Code log are mine. The longer structured ones, such as
  `prompt.txt`, were drafted with ChatGPT.
- So far, nothing in the harness or the eval cases has been written by hand. This section is updated if that changes.

## Prompt log

Real logs, trimmed only for secrets:

- `ai_log/claude-code/<session>.md`: readable version, with prompts and replies verbatim, tool calls on one line each
  and tool output left out.
- `ai_log/claude-code/<session>.jsonl`: the complete Claude Code transcript, with secrets redacted.
- Sessions exported so far:
  - `9c243027…`: first attempt, interrupted.
  - `39a68825…`: reading the brief, reassessing the plan, removing scheduling from the setup, changing the execution
    policy and guard, setting up the log exporter, phase 00 requirements, phase 01 reader/store, phase 02a LLM back end.
  - `1c7d5468…`: a separate short session I ran to check which tool calls the project guard blocks.
  - `4f8a7a0b…`: a separate session I ran while the first live ingest (H-003) seemed stuck (no progress output then),
    and to ask for a progress percentage against the README's requirements.
- To regenerate after each session: `.venv/Scripts/python.exe ai_log/export_claude_sessions.py`. The exporter's

- **Deferred:** the ChatGPT conversation (planning document, setup and prompt drafting) will go into
  `ai_log/chatgpt/` when I export it.

# My solution

Status 2026-10-17, work in progress. This file is updated as the harness grows; anything not yet built says so.

## How to run it

Python 3.11+ with `harness/requirements.txt` (`make setup`, or `python -m venv .venv` and
`.venv/Scripts/python.exe -m pip install -r harness/requirements.txt` on Windows). Nothing else is needed: the scan
OCR model ships inside `rapidocr-onnxruntime`, and nothing is downloaded at run time.

The grader's three commands are unchanged (`ingest`, `report --as-of --mode`, `feedback`). With `ANTHROPIC_API_KEY`
set, the harness calls Claude (`claude-opus-5-5`, set in `harness/nova/llm_config.json`) through the Anthropic SDK
and honours `ANTHROPIC_BASE_URL`. Without a key it uses a logged-in Claude Code CLI if one is on PATH, which is how I
ran it locally; the optional `harness/.local-llm.json` (gitignored; see `harness/local-llm.example.json`) lets that
CLI find its login inside the grader's stripped environment. With neither, it stops with an error rather than
returning an empty audit. Each step keeps to a 540 s budget; work that does not fit is saved and finished by the
next step. Progress lines (`extract k/N done ...`) go to stderr, the report to stdout.

## What works

- Reading: every email, PDF and Excel sheet with the grader's own reader (identical pages, so quotes resolve), UTC
  receipt times, resent files kept as separate occurrences, scans read by local OCR. Practice and exam mailboxes:
  163 and 86 documents, none unreadable.
- Extraction: one structured Claude call per email bundle, long PDFs in parallel chunks, large spreadsheets mapped by
  header and parsed row by row in Python. Every fact must quote its page; numbers and dates are checked against it;
  invoice arithmetic is checked and a misread document is re-read once. Live run on practice batch_01: 917 facts, 0
  rejected; agreement tables (rates, fuel, FX, accessorials, charge codes, Schedule 1) complete.
- 65 offline tests (synthetic data, no network) pass.

Not yet: findings. `report` prints a valid but empty report until the rules land, so there is no practice report
card or exam answer sheet yet.

## What doesn't

Not built yet: the class rules (overcharge, duplicate, waiver, late fees, cashback, expiry), conflicts and
cannot_determine, feedback application, actions in both modes, confidence, supersedes/retro, the embedding search
and RAG interpretation, and my own eval cases. The re-read has not yet been exercised on a live document. One run on
practice batch_01 took 399 s of the 600 s step limit; hidden batches with many long contracts could need more time,
in which case unfinished extraction is completed by the following step.

## The eval case that caught a bug

No `evals/` case exists yet. The offline tests have caught real bugs so far: a date check that accepted the wrong
day/month order; a validator that rejected dates at the end of a sentence (found by the first live run, fixed with a
regression test from that case); an arithmetic check whose 0.01 tolerance hid one-cent differences. This section will
name the eval case once the eval set exists.

## Submission status (against SUBMISSION.md)

| Item | Status |

# My solution

Status 2026-10-17, work in progress. This file is updated as the harness grows; anything not yet built says so.

## How to run it

Python 3.11+ with `harness/requirements.txt` (`make setup`, or `python -m venv .venv` and
`.venv/Scripts/python.exe -m pip install -r harness/requirements.txt` on Windows). Nothing else is needed: the scan
OCR model ships inside `rapidocr-onnxruntime`, and nothing is downloaded at run time.

The grader's three commands are unchanged (`ingest`, `report --as-of --mode`, `feedback`). With `ANTHROPIC_API_KEY`
set, the harness calls Claude (`claude-opus-5-5`, set in `harness/nova/llm_config.json`) through the Anthropic SDK
and honours `ANTHROPIC_BASE_URL`. Without a key it uses a logged-in Claude Code CLI if one is on PATH, which is how I
ran it locally; the optional `harness/.local-llm.json` (gitignored; see `harness/local-llm.example.json`) lets that
CLI find its login inside the grader's stripped environment. With neither, it stops with an error rather than
returning an empty audit. Each step keeps to a 540 s budget; work that does not fit is saved and finished by the
next step. Progress lines (`extract k/N done ...`) go to stderr, the report to stdout.

  header and parsed row by row in Python. Every fact must quote its page; numbers and dates are checked against it;

  rejected; agreement tables (rates, fuel, FX, accessorials, charge codes, Schedule 1) complete.

  annual improvement credit, expiry. Actions in both modes with the $5,000 sum and the five unattended checks.

# Design

Status 2026-10-17: ingestion, extraction and verification are built and tested; detection rules, feedback and
actions are being built. Items marked *(planned)* are not implemented yet.

## Fact model

Every email and attachment is an occurrence keyed by the path the grader cites (`batch_01/0003.eml#INV.pdf`), with
its UTC receipt time from the Date header, sender and page text from the grader's own reader (OCR for scans). A
resent identical file stays a separate occurrence. Claude transcribes each document into typed facts: contracts and
terms, rate/fuel/FX/accessorial rows, charge-code aliases, Schedule 1 people, invoices and lines, credit notes,
ledger and tracking rows, waivers, extensions, rate notices, status events. Every fact carries `{doc, page, quote}`.
Python accepts a fact only if the quote is on that page and its numbers and dates are too (date order learned per
sender); invoice arithmetic is checked, and a misread gets one targeted re-read. Money is a printed string parsed
to Decimal. All state is SQLite under `--state-dir`.

## Conflicts

*(planned)* Each term is chosen per pickup date from the documents in force: signed MSA and amendments first, then
Schedule 1 notices for that category, then feedback facts. The MSA's precedence clause ranks them. When two sources
with authority give different correct amounts and the clause does not rank them (amendment against a Schedule 1
rate notice), the key becomes a conflict with both sources cited and the range of possible overcharges. An
unauthorised sender, quoted text or an unsigned draft never creates a conflict; the stronger source decides.

## Confidence

*(planned)* An explicit score from evidence completeness (all governing documents held, pickup date from tracking),
source authority level, field verification status (ok, unverified, re-read), arithmetic consistency and agreement
across sources (AWB and tracking against the invoice). It is mapped to a probability and labelled heuristic until it
is checked on our own eval set. Similarity scores never feed it.

## People in the loop

*(planned)* Supervised mode never executes outbound actions: disputes, claims and document requests are drafts, and
anything of $5,000 or more summed per invoice or cashback key goes to human_review. In autonomous mode an action
executes only when all five unattended checks pass: complete evidence received by as_of with a tracked
pickup date, no conflict on that contract and lane, under $5,000, reversible, and every term from level 1–2 with a
Schedule 1 recipient. Conflicts always escalate. Mailbox text is data; instructions in it change nothing.

## Feedback

*(planned)* Feedback files are stored verbatim (built). Each decision becomes a level-2 fact effective from
`decided_at`, scoped by `applies_to` and its valid dates. A standing fact applies only when every filter matches;
a one-off decision touches only its key. Changed items carry `learned_at`. A later signed document beats feedback.

## New documents

Each batch is stored, then planned into extraction units (email bundles, long PDFs in parallel 4-page chunks,
large spreadsheets by column map). Answers are saved as each arrives, and unfinished work is retried by the next
step. Reports recompute everything from stored facts as of the requested date, so a backdated amendment changes
later reports but not earlier ones. *(planned)* Changed keys cite `supersedes`; keys that exist only because of a
backdated document set `retro`; stale keys disappear.

## Cost

Measured on practice batch_01 (82 documents) through Claude Code with `claude-opus-5-5`: 399 s, 165k output tokens,
122k cache-write and 395k cache-read tokens. At API prices ($4/$20 per million input/output, $0.20 cache read,
cache writes priced at 2× input) that is about $4.40 per batch, roughly $53 per 1,000 documents, 76% of it output.
Time was about 80 minutes per 1,000 documents at 4 parallel calls, before long PDFs were split into chunks. These
are estimates from one run; the grader's SDK path may differ.

## What I'd do next

Finish the class rules, feedback and action policy; then original evals and the exam audit. With more time: a
cheaper model for short emails and transcribing only rows a rule needs; local embeddings for unfamiliar charge
labels and clauses; measured confidence calibration. Least sure about: hidden-set layouts and wording.

ledger and tracking rows, waivers, extensions, rate notices, status events. Every fact carries `{doc, page, quote}`.
Python accepts a fact only if the quote is on that page and its numbers and dates are too (date order learned per
sender); invoice arithmetic is checked, and a misread gets one targeted re-read. Money is a printed string parsed
to Decimal. All state is SQLite under `--state-dir`.

## Conflicts

Each term is chosen per pickup date from the documents in force: signed MSA and amendments first (the latest
effective amendment wins), then rate notices, which count only when their sender is the Schedule 1 rates person.
The MSA's precedence clause, extracted as typed flags, ranks them. When two sources
with authority give different correct amounts and the clause does not rank them (amendment against a Schedule 1
rate notice), the key becomes a conflict with both sources cited and the range of possible overcharges. An
unauthorised sender, quoted text or an unsigned draft never creates a conflict; the stronger source decides.

## Confidence

A hand-set score: 0.95 for a fully evidenced deterministic result (0.85 conflict, 0.8 missing document), lowered for
a pickup date not from tracking, unverified fields, unpriced lines, INR conversion or thin evidence. It is labelled
heuristic until checked on our own eval set *(planned)*. Similarity scores never feed it.

## People in the loop

Supervised mode never executes outbound actions: disputes, claims and document requests are drafts, and
anything of $5,000 or more summed per invoice or cashback key goes to human_review. In autonomous mode an action
executes only when all five unattended checks pass: complete evidence received by as_of with a tracked
pickup date, no conflict on that contract and lane, under $5,000, reversible, and every term from level 1–2 with a
Schedule 1 recipient. Conflicts always escalate. Mailbox text is data; instructions in it change nothing.

## Feedback

*(planned)* Feedback files are stored verbatim (built). Each decision becomes a level-2 fact effective from
`decided_at`, scoped by `applies_to` and its valid dates. A standing fact applies only when every filter matches;
a one-off decision touches only its key. Changed items carry `learned_at`. A later signed document beats feedback.

## New documents

Each batch is stored, then planned into extraction units (email bundles, long PDFs in parallel 4-page chunks,
large spreadsheets by column map). Answers are saved as each arrives, and unfinished work is retried by the next
step. Reports recompute everything from stored facts as of the requested date, so a backdated amendment changes
later reports but not earlier ones. *(planned)* Changed keys cite `supersedes`; keys that exist only because of a
backdated document set `retro`; stale keys disappear.

## Cost

Measured on practice batch_01 (82 documents) through Claude Code with `claude-opus-5-5`: 399 s, 165k output tokens,
122k cache-write and 395k cache-read tokens. At API prices ($4/$20 per million input/output, $0.20 cache read,
cache writes priced at 2× input) that is about $4.40 per batch, roughly $53 per 1,000 documents, 76% of it output.
Time was about 80 minutes per 1,000 documents at 4 parallel calls, before long PDFs were split into chunks. These
are estimates from one run; the grader's SDK path may differ.

## What I'd do next

Finish the class rules, feedback and action policy; then original evals and the exam audit. With more time: a
cheaper model for short emails and transcribing only rows a rule needs; local embeddings for unfamiliar charge
labels and clauses; measured confidence calibration. Least sure about: hidden-set layouts and wording.

"""Late fees (GLOSSARY "Late fees").

Not owed: days_late = paid date - due date, where the due date is the extended one if the contract's payment-terms
contact extended it in their own email. No fee within the grace days; otherwise ceil(days_late / 30) months, each
round_half_up(r% x base): compounding bases add the earlier unpaid fees, simple bases do not. The finding is billed
fees minus the correct fee, on the invoice that billed them.

Risk: an unpaid invoice whose due date is 1-14 days after as_of: one month's fee on the open amount less anything
already disputed on it, in the invoice's currency (converted once later), deadline = the due date.
"""
from __future__ import annotations

import math
from decimal import Decimal

from ..money import dec, q2
from ..world import World, norm_id, norm_label, to_date
from .common import Candidate
from .duplicate import _ledger

ZERO = Decimal("0")
OPEN = ("open", "unpaid", "outstanding", "due", "overdue")


def due_date(world: World, contract, inv: str, ledger_row, header) -> tuple:
    """(due date, the extension fact used or None). Only the payment-terms contact's own email extends it."""
    due = to_date(ledger_row.get("due_date")) if ledger_row is not None else None
    if due is None and header is not None:
        due = to_date(header.get("due_date"))
    best = None
    for f in world.of("due_date_extensions"):
        if norm_id(f.get("invoice_id")) != inv or f.get("is_quoted_or_forwarded"):
            continue
        if contract is None or not contract.authority(world.sender(f.doc), "payment_terms"):
            continue
        new = to_date(f.get("new_due_date"))
        if new and (best is None or world.docs[f.doc].received_at > world.docs[best.doc].received_at):
            best = f
    if best is not None:
        return to_date(best.get("new_due_date")), best
    return due, None


def correct_fee(principal: Decimal, pct: Decimal, days_late: int, grace: int, compounding: bool) -> tuple:
    if days_late <= grace or days_late <= 0:
        return ZERO, []
    months = math.ceil(days_late / 30)
    base, total, steps = principal, ZERO, []
    for i in range(months):
        fee = q2(pct / 100 * base)
        steps.append({"month": i + 1, "base": str(base), "fee": str(fee)})
        total += fee
        if compounding:
            base += fee
    return total, steps


def detect(world: World, disputed=lambda inv: ZERO) -> list[Candidate]:
    found = []
    ledger = _ledger(world)
    headers = {norm_id(h.get("invoice_id")): h for h in world.of("invoices")}
    # ---- fees billed that are not owed -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
    by_invoice: dict[str, list] = {}
    for ln in world.of("invoice_lines"):
        hdr = headers.get(norm_id(ln.get("invoice_id")))
        contract = world.contract_of(hdr.get("contract_id")) if hdr else None
        is_late = (contract.code_for(ln.get("charge_label")) == "LATE") if contract else False
        if is_late or "latefee" in norm_label(ln.get("charge_label")):
            by_invoice.setdefault(norm_id(ln.get("invoice_id")), []).append(ln)
    for inv, fee_lines in by_invoice.items():
        hdr = headers.get(inv)
        contract = world.contract_of(hdr.get("contract_id")) if hdr else None
        if contract is None:
            continue
        pay = contract.block("payment")
        pct, grace = dec(pay.get("late_fee_pct_per_month")), int(dec(pay.get("grace_days")) or 0)
        if pct is None:
            continue
        per_target: dict[str, list] = {}
        for ln in fee_lines:
            per_target.setdefault(norm_id(ln.get("refers_to_invoice")), []).append(ln)
        billed_total, correct_total, steps, evidence = ZERO, ZERO, [], []
        for target, lines in per_target.items():
            row = ledger.get(target)
            paid = to_date(row.get("paid_date")) if row is not None else None
            due, ext = due_date(world, contract, target, row, headers.get(target))
            principal = (dec(row.get("amount")) if row is not None else None) or dec(lines[0].get("base_amount"))
            if not target or paid is None or due is None or principal is None:
                continue                                    # cannot judge without paid date, due date and principal
            principal -= disputed(target)
            days = (paid - due).days
            correct, fee_steps = correct_fee(principal, pct, days, grace, bool(pay.get("compounding")))
            billed = sum((dec(x.get("amount")) or ZERO for x in lines), ZERO)
            billed_total += billed
            correct_total += correct
            steps.append({"late_invoice": target, "due": str(due), "extended_by": ext.doc if ext else None,
                          "paid": str(paid), "days_late": days, "grace": grace, "pct": str(pct),
                          "principal": str(principal), "fees": fee_steps, "correct": str(correct),
                          "billed": str(billed)})
            if billed > correct:
                if ext is not None:
                    evidence.append(ext.evidence())
                if row is not None:
                    evidence.append(row.evidence())
                evidence += [x.evidence() for x in lines]
        over = billed_total - correct_total
        if over > 0:
            c = Candidate("late_fee_not_owed", {"invoice_id": inv, "class": "late_fee_not_owed"}, "finding",
                          amount_usd=q2(over), outbound="dispute", contract_id=contract.id,
                          signals={"currency": (hdr.get("currency") or "USD").upper()},
                          trace={"formula": "late_fee.billed_minus_correct", "targets": steps})
            for ev in evidence:
                c.add_evidence(ev)
            if pay.get("source"):
                c.add_evidence(pay["source"] | {"page": pay["source"].get("page") or 1})
            found.append(c)
    # ---- unpaid invoices about to start costing a fee ---------------------------------------------------------------
    for inv, row in ledger.items():
        if str(row.get("status") or "").lower() not in OPEN or row.get("paid_date"):
            continue
        hdr = headers.get(inv)
        contract = world.contract_of(hdr.get("contract_id")) if hdr else None
        if contract is None and len(world.contracts) == 1:
            contract = next(iter(world.contracts.values()))
        if contract is None:

"""Late fees (GLOSSARY "Late fees").

Not owed: days_late = paid date - due date, where the due date is the extended one if the contract's payment-terms
contact extended it in their own email. No fee within the grace days; otherwise ceil(days_late / 30) months, each
round_half_up(r% x base): compounding bases add the earlier unpaid fees, simple bases do not. The finding is billed
fees minus the correct fee, on the invoice that billed them.

Risk: an unpaid invoice whose due date is 1-14 days after as_of: one month's fee on the open amount less anything
already disputed on it, in the invoice's currency (converted once later), deadline = the due date.
"""
from __future__ import annotations

import math
from decimal import Decimal

from ..money import dec, q2
from ..world import World, norm_id, norm_label, to_date
from .common import Candidate
from .duplicate import _ledger

ZERO = Decimal("0")
OPEN = ("open", "unpaid", "outstanding", "due", "overdue")


def due_date(world: World, contract, inv: str, ledger_row, header) -> tuple:
    """(due date, the extension fact used or None). Only the payment-terms contact's own email extends it."""
    due = to_date(ledger_row.get("due_date")) if ledger_row is not None else None
    if due is None and header is not None:
        due = to_date(header.get("due_date"))
    best = None
    for f in world.of("due_date_extensions"):
        if norm_id(f.get("invoice_id")) != inv or f.get("is_quoted_or_forwarded"):
            continue
        if contract is None or world.authorized(contract, f.doc, "payment_terms")[0] is None:
            continue
        new = to_date(f.get("new_due_date"))
        if new and (best is None or world.docs[f.doc].received_at > world.docs[best.doc].received_at):
            best = f
    if best is not None:
        return to_date(best.get("new_due_date")), best
    return due, None


def correct_fee(principal: Decimal, pct: Decimal, days_late: int, grace: int, compounding: bool) -> tuple:
    if days_late <= grace or days_late <= 0:
        return ZERO, []
    months = math.ceil(days_late / 30)
    base, total, steps = principal, ZERO, []
    for i in range(months):
        fee = q2(pct / 100 * base)
        steps.append({"month": i + 1, "base": str(base), "fee": str(fee)})
        total += fee
        if compounding:
            base += fee
    return total, steps


def detect(world: World, disputed=lambda inv: ZERO) -> list[Candidate]:
    found = []
    ledger = _ledger(world)
    headers = {norm_id(h.get("invoice_id")): h for h in world.of("invoices")}
    # ---- fees billed that are not owed -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
    by_invoice: dict[str, list] = {}
    for ln in world.of("invoice_lines"):
        hdr = headers.get(norm_id(ln.get("invoice_id")))
        contract = world.contract_of(hdr.get("contract_id")) if hdr else None
        is_late = (contract.code_for(ln.get("charge_label")) == "LATE") if contract else False
        if is_late or "latefee" in norm_label(ln.get("charge_label")):
            by_invoice.setdefault(norm_id(ln.get("invoice_id")), []).append(ln)
    for inv, fee_lines in by_invoice.items():
        hdr = headers.get(inv)
        contract = world.contract_of(hdr.get("contract_id")) if hdr else None
        if contract is None:
            continue
        pay = contract.block("payment")
        pct, grace = dec(pay.get("late_fee_pct_per_month")), int(dec(pay.get("grace_days")) or 0)
        if pct is None:
            continue
        per_target: dict[str, list] = {}
        for ln in fee_lines:
            per_target.setdefault(norm_id(ln.get("refers_to_invoice")), []).append(ln)
        billed_total, correct_total, steps, evidence = ZERO, ZERO, [], []
        for target, lines in per_target.items():
            row = ledger.get(target)
            paid = to_date(row.get("paid_date")) if row is not None else None
            due, ext = due_date(world, contract, target, row, headers.get(target))
            principal = (dec(row.get("amount")) if row is not None else None) or dec(lines[0].get("base_amount"))
            if not target or paid is None or due is None or principal is None:
                continue                                    # cannot judge without paid date, due date and principal
            principal -= disputed(target)
            days = (paid - due).days
            correct, fee_steps = correct_fee(principal, pct, days, grace, bool(pay.get("compounding")))
            billed = sum((dec(x.get("amount")) or ZERO for x in lines), ZERO)
            billed_total += billed
            correct_total += correct
            steps.append({"late_invoice": target, "due": str(due), "extended_by": ext.doc if ext else None,
                          "paid": str(paid), "days_late": days, "grace": grace, "pct": str(pct),
                          "principal": str(principal), "fees": fee_steps, "correct": str(correct),
                          "billed": str(billed)})
            if billed > correct:
                if ext is not None:
                    evidence.append(ext.evidence())
                if row is not None:
                    evidence.append(row.evidence())
                evidence += [x.evidence() for x in lines]
        over = billed_total - correct_total
        if over > 0:
            c = Candidate("late_fee_not_owed", {"invoice_id": inv, "class": "late_fee_not_owed"}, "finding",
                          amount_usd=q2(over), outbound="dispute", contract_id=contract.id,
                          signals={"currency": (hdr.get("currency") or "USD").upper()},
                          trace={"formula": "late_fee.billed_minus_correct", "targets": steps})
            for ev in evidence:
                c.add_evidence(ev)
            if pay.get("source"):
                c.add_evidence(pay["source"] | {"page": pay["source"].get("page") or 1})
            found.append(c)
    # ---- unpaid invoices about to start costing a fee ---------------------------------------------------------------
    for inv, row in ledger.items():
        if str(row.get("status") or "").lower() not in OPEN or row.get("paid_date"):
            continue
        hdr = headers.get(inv)
        contract = world.contract_of(hdr.get("contract_id")) if hdr else None
        if contract is None and len(world.contracts) == 1:
            contract = next(iter(world.contracts.values()))
        if contract is None:
            continue
        pay = contract.block("payment")
        pct = dec(pay.get("late_fee_pct_per_month"))
        due, ext = due_date(world, contract, inv, row, hdr)
        amount = dec(row.get("amount"))
        if pct is None or due is None or amount is None:
            continue
        gap = (due - world.as_of_date).days
        if not 0 < gap <= 14:
            continue
        principal = amount - disputed(inv)
        fee = q2(pct / 100 * principal)
        c = Candidate("late_fee_risk", {"invoice_id": inv, "class": "late_fee_risk"}, "finding", amount_usd=fee,
                      deadline=due.isoformat(), internal="payment_reminder", contract_id=contract.id,
                      signals={"currency": (row.get("currency") or (hdr.get("currency") if hdr else None) or "USD").upper(),
                               "invoice_date": row.get("invoice_date")},
                      trace={"formula": "late_fee.one_month_risk", "principal": str(principal), "pct": str(pct),
                             "due": str(due), "days_to_due": gap})
        c.add_evidence(row.evidence())
        if ext is not None:
            c.add_evidence(ext.evidence())
        if pay.get("source"):
            c.add_evidence(pay["source"] | {"page": pay["source"].get("page") or 1})
        found.append(c)
    return found
